title: GTA6 New Artwork Sparks Discussion Over Lucia's Ankle Monitor Placement
description: Reddit users spot a curious detail in the new GTA6 artwork where Lucia's ankle monitor appears on her left leg instead of the right.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 New Artwork Sparks Discussion Over Lucia's Ankle Monitor Placement

The *Grand Theft Auto VI* community on Reddit is buzzing once again over a minor yet fascinating detail spotted in Rockstar Games' latest promotional materials. According to a post shared by community user /u/WeGotThisBeforeGTA7, there appears to be an inconsistency regarding protagonist Lucia's ankle monitor placement across the newly released artwork.

### A Keen-Eyed Community Discovery

As pointed out by eagle-eyed fans, one of the newly released promotional artworks shows Lucia with her characteristic GPS ankle monitor placed on her left leg. However, in a second newly released artwork from the same batch, the monitor is correctly positioned back on her right leg as seen previously.

This discrepancy has quickly become a talking point within the r/GTA6 subreddit, showcasing just how closely the community analyzes every single frame, screenshot, and piece of official artwork released by Rockstar Games.

### Context and Community Reactions

* **Unconfirmed Community Observation**: It is important to note that this detail is purely based on community observation from Reddit and remains an unconfirmed visual quirk. Asset flipping, mirroring, or simple artistic variations during the promotional material creation process are common in the industry.
* **The Significance of the Monitor**: The ankle monitor has been a key visual indicator of Lucia's legal troubles and back-story since she was first revealed in the game's debut trailer. Fans have continuously tracked how this element ties into her narrative arc.
* **Fan Engagement**: Incidents like this highlight the relentless passion of the GTA6 fanbase, who scrutinize every piece of media while waiting for further updates from Rockstar.

### Editor's Take

While this ankle monitor mix-up is likely just a minor graphic or mirroring oversight in the promotional rollout, it highlights the incredible scrutiny the GTA6 community applies to everything Rockstar releases. It's a fun reminder of how engaged the fanbase is while we all await the next major official update.
